'''Aldar Beedo''' was a [[Glymphid]] [[Gender|male]] [[Podracer (profession)|podracer]] from the [[planet]] [[Ploo II]] who participated in the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|podrace]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY]]. Beedo flew a [[Aldar Beedo's Podracer|podracer]] with [[Mk IV Flat Twin Turbojet]] [[Podracer engine|engines]] and began on the front row of the starting grid in the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena]].

Throughout the first lap he moved up and down within the group of racers leading the race, but was overtaken by the [[human]] [[pilot]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] in the second lap before dropping into the [[Ebe Crater Valley]]. Ultimately, he finished in a respectable third place behind the racers [[Gasgano]] and Skywalker.

==Biography==
[[File:AldarBeedosPodracer--NTIP.png|thumb|left|250px|Aldar Beedo flew a podracer with Mk IV Flat Twin Turbojet engines.]]
Hailing from the [[planet]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Crisis on Naboo}}</ref> [[Ploo II]], the [[Glymphid]] [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Geektionary" /> Aldar Beedo had become a [[Podracer (profession)|podracer]] by [[32 BBY]], when he was one of the participants in the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|podrace]] on the planet [[Tatooine]].<ref name="Falcon">{{BuildFalconCite|51|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref> He was given the left-most position on the front row of the race's starting grid<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> in the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena]],<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> but after the [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] signaled for the race to begin he was not initially in the lead pack of vehicles as they flew through<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> the [[Mushroom Mesa]].<ref name="CL" />

After the [[Dug]] podracer [[Sebulba]] caused the racer [[Mawhonic]] to crash, Beedo moved up into fourth place behind fellow racers<ref name="TPM" /> [[Elan Mak]] and [[Ratts Tyerell]],<ref name="CL" /> with Sebulba in the lead as they entered<ref name="TPM" /> [[the Notch]].<ref name="CL" /> By the time they reached<ref name="TPM" /> [[Arch Canyon]],<ref name="CL" /> Beedo had moved up to third<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> behind his opponent [[Teemto Pagalies]] and then Sebulba, although the Glymphid fell behind again before they entered the<ref name="TPM" /> [[Laguna Caves]],<ref name="CL" /> but was still following closely behind the Dug.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Beedo sat in fifth place as the lead racers crossed<ref name="TPM" /> the [[Hutt Flats]]<ref name="CL" /> before finishing the first lap.<ref name="TPM" />

[[File:Beedos_flag.svg|thumb|right|250px|Beedo's flag]]
In the second lap, the [[human]] podracer [[Anakin Skywalker]] overtook Beedo just before they dropped<ref name="TPM" /> into the [[Ebe Crater Valley]],<ref name="CL" /> and by the third lap, Skywalker and Sebulba were well out in front of the other racers. Ultimately, Sebulba crashed and Skywalker claimed first place,<ref name="TPM" /> with Beedo finishing in a respectable third place<ref name="CVD" /> behind the [[Xexto]] pilot [[Gasgano]] despite the Glymphid's best efforts.<ref name="Geektionary" /> Beedo finished with a [[time]] of 15.52:108 and averaged 845 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]] (528 [[Mile per hour|miles per hour]]) during the race.<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Aldar Beedo was a long-snouted Glymphid<ref name="Geektionary" /> who was devious and skillful.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> He had mottled [[Color|green]] and yellow skin with some blue coloring on the skin around his orange [[eye]]s.<ref name="CVD" />

==Equipment==
Aldar Beedo flew a 22.5 [[meter]] (74.25 [[Foot|feet]]) long [[Aldar Beedo's Podracer|podracer]], the longest [[Podracer|vehicle]] participating in the Boonta Eve Classic. It used<ref name="CV">''[[Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition]]''</ref> [[Manta RamAir]] [[Mk IV Flat Twin Turbojet]] [[engine]]s<ref name="EV">''[[Endless Vigil]]''</ref> with blue and red coloring.<ref name="CV" /> Beedo's flag consisted of a blue background with a green emblem in the middle and green corners on the upper left and lower right.<ref name="CVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aldar Beedo was created for the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="TPM" /> which was released on [[May 19]], [[1999]].<ref name="YbY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The character's name appeared as early as the revised rough draft of the film's script, which listed Beedo as coming from [[Kamar]]. At least four pieces of concept art of the character were created in [[1996]], with concept artist [[Terryl Whitlatch]] creating anatomical sketches dated [[March 19]] and [[March 27]].<ref name="InsidersGuide">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref>

[[File:BeedoConceptArt.png|thumb|right|250px|Terryl Whitlatch drew concept art of Aldar Beedo.]]
After the concept sketches established Beedo's look, a maquette of the character was built in order to fully realize his three-dimensional shape and color scheme. Despite the level of detailed provided by the maquette, the racer only appeared in the film as a low-resolution computer generated model visible in distant shots of the cockpit of his podracer during the race.<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|aldarbeedo|Beedo, Aldar}}</ref>

In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Beedo's name was first used in the [[2015]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''.<ref name="AEYNTK">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Beedo]] appeared prior to the release of the film in its [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|novelization]], which was written by [[Terry Brooks]]<ref name="Novel">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref> and released on [[April 21]], 1999.<ref name="YbY" />
